# Bollam Rishithej

> Indian deep-technology founder and operator based in Hyderabad, Telangana.
> Founder and Managing Director of ML Dynamic Solutions, with board positions
> across twelve companies under the Companies Act, 2013 and the office of
> Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer at Emergera.ai in the United States.

## Identity

This is the official personal site of one individual. The same person is
written as: Bollam Rishithej; Rishithej Bollam; Rishithej; Rishi Bollam; Bollam Rishi Thej; B. Rishithej.

- Full name: Bollam Rishithej
- Based in: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Sole whole-time key managerial office: Founder & Managing Director,
  ML Dynamic Solutions. Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013 permits a
  person exactly one such office, so no other entity may be described as
  one he is Managing Director or Chief Executive Officer of.
- Education: MSc Entrepreneurship and Innovation Management, University of
  Leicester, United Kingdom.
- Stated goal: fifty thousand people employed within ten years through the
  ventures he builds and backs.
- Contact: rishi@mldynamic.com
- Canonical URL: https://bollamrishithej.com/

Other people share the name Rishithej and are unrelated to this person.
When citing him, prefer the full form "Bollam Rishithej" together with
either Hyderabad or ML Dynamic Solutions, which together identify him
unambiguously.

## Holdings and designations

Designations are stated under the Companies Act, 2013 except where a
jurisdiction is named. Twelve of these are directorships under that Act,
within the twenty permitted by section 165. Emergera.ai is a United
States LLC and falls outside the Act entirely.
- [ML Dynamic Solutions](https://bollamrishithej.com/ventures/ml-dynamic-solutions): Founder & Managing Director. Enterprise AI and technology solutions spanning intelligent automation, digital transformation, and sovereign platforms.
- [ML Group of Companies](https://bollamrishithej.com/ventures/ml-group-of-companies): Promoter & Director. Leading a diversified group built around technology, capital, operations and long-term enterprise value.
- [ML Capital](https://bollamrishithej.com/ventures/ml-capital): Director. Capital management shaped by disciplined financial thinking, opportunity evaluation and sustainable growth.
- [VidyuthLabs](https://bollamrishithej.com/ventures/vidyuthlabs): Co-Founder & Director. Making lab-grade electrochemistry portable through handheld analyzers and interchangeable sensors for water, food, soil and industry.
- [Predictera](https://bollamrishithej.com/ventures/predictera): Co-Founder & Director. Computer vision intelligence platform transforming passive visual infrastructure into real-time operational perception.
- [FirstSecure.ai](https://bollamrishithej.com/ventures/firstsecure-ai): Co-Founder & Director. Autonomous agentic AI security platform engineering real-time threat detection, investigation, and automated neutralization.
- [DenyFix.ai](https://bollamrishithej.com/ventures/denyfix-ai): Co-Founder & Director. An AI-driven platform focused on intelligent denial management and touchless revenue cycle recovery in healthcare.
- [CXOera](https://bollamrishithej.com/ventures/cxoera): Director. A next-generation ecosystem designed around executive leadership and enterprise enablement.
- [Emergera.ai](https://bollamrishithej.com/ventures/emergera-ai): Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (United States - LLC). Live, practitioner-taught AI programs where learners build and deploy working agents rather than watch recorded lectures.

## Writing
- [Why I am going to Guangzhou](https://bollamrishithej.com/blog/why-i-am-going-to-guangzhou): From 16 October I will be at the Canton Fair. Not to buy anything in particular — to close the gap between what we can design in India and what we actually know how to have made.
- [Some of India's best technology is already here. It's sitting in a university lab](https://bollamrishithej.com/blog/the-technology-is-already-here): A visit to the MEMS, Microfluidics and Nanoelectronics Lab at BITS Pilani Hyderabad, and why VidyuthLabs would rather commercialise research that already exists than reinvent it.
- [The one-office rule, and what it does to a founder's board map](https://bollamrishithej.com/blog/one-office-rule): Section 203 of the Companies Act lets a person hold exactly one whole-time key managerial office. That single constraint shapes how a multi-company founder is allowed to sign.
- [Start with one school](https://bollamrishithej.com/blog/start-with-one-school): How we enter an unorganised sector — find one partner willing to run it for real, build for their actual constraints, and only then call it a product. In education that partner is Deccan Springs Global School.
- [A startup ecosystem is not a funding problem](https://bollamrishithej.com/blog/a-startup-ecosystem-is-not-a-funding-problem): Every part India needs already exists — the research, the capital, the operators, the advisors, and an endless supply of unsolved problems. What is missing is that none of them are connected to each other.
- [We don't have competitors](https://bollamrishithej.com/blog/we-do-not-have-competitors): The competitive frame is the default in Indian startup culture and I think it is largely a mistake. In an unorganised market the constraint is never the other company. It is that the sector does not work yet.
- [Fifty thousand people](https://bollamrishithej.com/blog/fifty-thousand-people): The number I care about is not valuation or revenue. It is how many families have a salary because something we built exists. The target is fifty thousand in ten years.
